clauses.text: A line is a duplicate when it matches a line already processed for the same member, billing provider, date of service, procedure code, modifiers and units.
If the earlier line was paid, the duplicate denial is correct. No resubmission or appeal should be made.
A service performed again on the same day must be billed with modifier 76 when the same clinician repeated it, or 77 when a different clinician did. The record must show each performance separately.

A claim that changes one already processed must be sent as a replacement that gives the original claim number. If it is sent as a new claim it is denied as a duplicate, and the provider should send it again as a replacement.
